title: 3-Phase BL0906 Energy Metering Schematic
desc:
I need a complete schematic that lets the BL0906 energy-meter IC into a three-phase design and talk to it through a standalone STM32F103CBT6. The STM32 only has one job: grab raw registers from the BL0906, crunch RMS voltage and current, active power, active energy, fault flags and line frequency, then pass the results to my main controller (an ESP32) over SPI, which is the fixed interface for this project.

Key electrical details
• Current input must accept either conventional CTs or voltage-output sensors through a jumper-selectable.
• Voltage sensing is handled by a ZMPT101B module.  
• I want a well-calibrated passive filter stage on every phase to tame mains transients and high-frequency noise before they reach the BL0906. Keep the cut-off practical for 50/60 Hz metering accuracy while giving good surge immunity.
• Calibration option required for accuracy.

What I expect from you
• A clear, production-ready schematic (PDF + editable file in KiCad ).  
• Annotated BOM with part numbers that are easy to source.  
• Brief design notes explaining CT burden selection, jumper logic and the passive filter design so I can tweak values if my sensor mix changes later.

title: Talented Copywriter for Ongoing Projects
desc:
I’m building a steady stream of tasks that need to become crisp, persuasive copy. To do that, I want to partner with a skilled writer—specifically someone who lives and breathes copywriting.  

Expect to work on short-form and mid-length pieces such as landing pages, ad headlines, product blurbs, and email sequences. Turnaround can be fast, so the ability to absorb a brief quickly, ask sharp questions, and deliver clean, engaging text on schedule is essential. Google Docs (or a comparable cloud editor) will be our shared workspace; familiarity with basic on-page SEO and CTA placement is a plus, though not mandatory.  

Deliverables  
• Finished copy for each assigned task, ready to publish  
• Up to two revision rounds per piece  
• Final text supplied as shared Google Doc links with clear file names  

To start the conversation, please send two recent samples that demonstrate your knack for conversion-focused writing and include a note on how long you typically need for a 300-word assignment. I’ll set up individual milestones for each new brief so both of us stay clear on scope, timeline, and payment.  

Looking forward to seeing how your words can lift these projects.

title: 6-Lane Pier Table Reinforcement BBS -- 3
desc:
6-Lane Pier Table BBS

* Preparation of **Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) for 6-lane pier table reinforcement** based on approved structural drawings and reinforcement details.
* The freelancer shall prepare **accurate cutting lengths, bar marks, bar diameters, spacing, shape codes, quantities, unit weights and total steel quantities** for all pier table reinforcement.
* BBS shall cover **bottom/top reinforcement, longitudinal and transverse reinforcement, distribution bars, extra/anchorage reinforcement, U-bars, chairs and other reinforcement as detailed in the drawings**.
* The BBS shall be prepared in **Excel format**, properly cross-checked with drawings and suitable for **site execution, bar cutting, bending and quantity reconciliation**.
* Freelancer shall coordinate with the site/structural team for **clarifications and corrections** and submit the final BBS after incorporating all comments.
* **High accuracy is mandatory**, as the BBS will be directly used for reinforcement fabrication and site execution.

title: Patronista Lencería y Corsetería Creativa
desc:
Necesito un patronista con experiencia real tanto en lencería como en corsetería. El objetivo es transformar mi colección de referencia —te haré llegar un set de imágenes que ilustran líneas, detalles y acabados— en patrones digitales listos para producción.

Requisitos técnicos: Desarrollo de moldería base y escalado enfocado en calce anatómico y ergonomía (priorizando el ajuste en cuerpos reales y no en tablas genéricas rígidas). Valoro que domines software de patronaje (CLO, Optitex, Lectra o similar) y que sepas preparar archivos en formatos compatibles con láser/plotter.

Muéstrame piezas anteriores; con ver tus patrones terminados o fotos del producto final me basta para evaluar tu estilo y precisión. No necesito propuestas extensas, solo evidencias de que ya has desarrollado lencería y corsés que encajen bien, mantengan soporte y luzcan limpios en confección.

Inicio del proyecto:
Tan pronto cerremos el acuerdo, te entregaré las imágenes de inspiración y el estilo de prendas que busco. El/la patronista seleccionado/a desarrollará o adaptará la tabla de medidas ergonómica, además de calcular los porcentajes de elasticidad según los materiales e insumos previstos.

Entregables requeridos:
• Patrones digitales en PDF/A0 y DXF  
• Ficha técnica breve con indicaciones de montaje y consumos 
• Moldería base y escalado completo: Desarrollo del patrón inicial y graduación técnica en 4 tallas (S, M, L y XL) por cada modelo, garantizando la proporción y el calce anatómico en cad

title: German 15-Minute Scripted Discussion
desc:
I need native German speakers to read a short, pre-written script that runs for roughly fifteen minutes. 

I will supply the full script in advance so you have time to get comfortable with the wording and flow; the goal is to sound natural, as though you are chatting spontaneously even though the lines are provided. 

If you are a native speaker with a clear accent and can record in a quiet space, I’d love to hear a short voice sample and your earliest availability.

title: Tech Website Content Developer
desc:
I run a US staffing company with several customer-facing sites, and I need fresh website copy that gives visitors crystal-clear, in-depth information about each of ourservices. The goal is to replace the placeholder text we currently have with authoritative, engaging content that speaks both to technical buyers and to non-technical decision makers.

You will be writing full web pages rather than short blog pieces. Each page must:  
• Explain what the service we do, how it works, and the problems it solves  
• Highlight key specifications in plain language without losing technical accuracy  
• Encourage action through a concise yet persuasive tone

Because these pages are central to our sales funnel, accuracy is critical. I will provide product briefs, datasheets, and access to our engineers so you can verify every detail. Familiarity with common tech industry terminology, SaaS models, and B2B tone will help you excel.

Deliverables:  
• Draft copy for the homepage and the main product pages (approx. 6–8 pages, 500–700 words each)  
• A short meta description for each page to support on-page SEO  
• One revision round per page after internal review

Please share your tech website content portfolio

title: Fotógrafo de Productos para E-commerce
desc:
Necesitamos contratar a un fotógrafo de productos ubicado en Santiago de Chile para realizar una sesión fotográfica destinada a nuestro e-commerce. Los productos pertenecen a la industria de alimentos y bebidas, principalmente productos similares a los que se exhiben en góndolas de supermercado. En nuestro caso, se trata especialmente de café envasado y accesorios relacionados.

El trabajo consiste en:

- Tomar fotografías profesionales de nuestros productos.
- Editar y retocar las imágenes.
- Entregar las fotografías listas para publicar en una tienda online, con buena iluminación, colores fieles y fondo adecuado para e-commerce.
- Entregar los archivos finales en alta calidad y en formato optimizado para web.

No es necesario que el fotógrafo cuente con estudio propio, ya que disponemos de un espacio en Santiago donde se puede realizar la sesión. El profesional deberá contar con su propio equipo fotográfico y, de ser necesario, elementos de iluminación y fondo.

Si el fotógrafo dispone de un estudio o espacio propio, también podemos evaluar realizar la sesión allí. Ambas modalidades son viables y serán consideradas según las propuestas recibidas.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia en fotografía de productos, idealmente con trabajos previos para e-commerce.

Al postular, agradeceremos indicar:

- Valor del servicio.
- Cantidad de fotografías o productos incluidos.
- Plazo de entrega.
- Disponibilidad.
- Si cuenta con estudio propio o prefiere trabajar en nuestro espacio.

title: Mixed Data Entry From PDFs
desc:
I have a collection of PDF files that contain a blend of text and numerical information. I need every field from these digital documents keyed into a clean, structured template that I will supply before we start. Accuracy is critical—names, figures, dates, and any descriptive notes must match the source exactly, with the original layout reflected logically in the new sheet.

You’ll work directly from the PDFs, so confidence using PDF readers, quick-look shortcuts, or copy-paste tools (where possible) will help. If any characters fail to render or numbers appear ambiguous, flag them so I can clarify rather than guessing.

When the last file is complete, simply return the filled template along with a brief note confirming any items you had to verify. That’s it—straightforward, detail-focused data entry from PDF to my preferred format.

title: Accurate Word Data Entry
desc:
I have several documents that need to be transcribed into a single, clean Microsoft Word file. The source material will arrive in mixed formats—scanned pages, digital PDFs, and the occasional handwritten note—and I simply need the contents reproduced faithfully.  

Stick to straightforward text formatting: clear paragraphs, matching headings where they naturally appear, and consistent spacing. No custom templates or advanced layout work is required; accuracy and a tidy, error-free .docx are what matter most.  

If you have an eye for detail, solid typing speed, and can turn the work around promptly, let’s get started.

title: PhD Qualitative Data Analysis
desc:
I'm seeking an experienced data analyst to assist with my PhD research. The project involves analyzing qualitative data using SPSS.

Key Requirements:
- Analyze qualitative data
- Perform descriptive and regression analysis
- Deliver insights and detailed reports

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Expertise in SPSS
- Strong background in qualitative data analysis
- Experience with both descriptive and regression statistics
- Detail-oriented and able to meet deadlines

Please provide samples of previous work and relevant qualifications. Looking forward to your proposals!

title: Word Document Data Entry
desc:
I will supply a batch of digital Word files containing plain text that must be transferred, word-for-word, into the template I provide. Everything is already typed, so the task centres on careful copying, consistent formatting, and a final spell-check to be sure nothing is missed.  
Return the completed template in the same sequence as the original documents and highlight any portions that seem unclear. Accuracy and a quick, reliable turnaround are the only metrics I will use to sign off the job.

title: Video Editing & PDF Extraction
desc:
I have two parallel tasks I’d like handled together. 

First, I’ll be sending over several short marketing clips that need professional editing. We can decide together whether they simply need trimming or something more creative—transitions, text overlays, or colour tweaks—but the end goal is a polished video ready for social posting in MP4.

Second, I need data pulled from a batch of PDF documents and placed into well-structured Excel sheets. The key requirement here is accurate extraction; each field in the PDF must land in the correct column so I can run formulas and pivot tables without further cleanup. The faster you can move from raw PDFs to a tidy Excel workbook, the better.

If you’re comfortable switching between Premiere Pro (or another editor you prefer) and Excel—and you’ve done PDF-to-spreadsheet work before—let’s work out a timeline and get started.

title: Amazon Images & A+ Content Creation
desc:
I am preparing a new Home & Kitchen item for launch on Amazon and need a full set of bright, colorful visuals that put its functionality front and center.  

Deliverables  
• 7 Amazon-ready listing images (primary on pure white, plus lifestyle and infographic shots, 2000 px minimum)  
• 1 short lifestyle video, under 60 seconds, optimized for silent autoplay with on-screen text  
• 10 wide A+ Content banner images  
• 1 looping hero video for the A+ module  

Everything must follow Amazon’s image, ratio, and file-size guidelines. Lifestyle scenes should place the product naturally in a vibrant kitchen setting while highlighting exactly how it works. I will supply raw photos and basic clips; you can add licensed stock or motion graphics as needed.  

Final files should include high-resolution JPEG/PNG for images, 1080p MP4 for video, and the editable PSD/AI and Premiere or After Effects or canva project files so I can tweak them later.  

Acceptance criteria  
• All assets pass Amazon’s uploader checks  
• Consistent brightness, color grading, and typography  
• Clear emphasis on the product’s key functional benefits  

Please show at least one previous Amazon listing or A+ project that uses a similarly bright and colorful style for a Home & Kitchen product to help me evaluate fit.

desc:

title: Fresh Produce Wholesale Sales Representative
desc:
I need a results-driven sales representative who can move our fresh produce line into the hands of local wholesale buyers. We farm, pack, and ship a rotating selection of seasonal fruits and vegetables and now want to deepen our presence in local markets, cash-and-carry outlets, and independent grocery chains.  

You should already understand the rhythm of produce buying cycles, know how to speak the language of produce managers, and be comfortable negotiating pallet-level pricing on tight timelines. A solid book of contacts within regional wholesalers or market stall operators will help you hit the ground running; I am ready to supply samples, spec sheets, and pricing grids as soon as you identify interested buyers.  

Deliverables I will use to gauge success:  
• A weekly report summarising approaches made, leads generated, and orders closed  
• Signed purchase orders or clear email confirmations from new wholesale clients  
• Feedback from prospects that can refine our packaging, sizing, or variety mix  

If you are accustomed to walking market floors early in the morning, closing deals on the phone in the afternoon, and keeping meticulous track of volumes and margins, let’s talk.

title: SMS Appointment Setter for UK warm leads
desc:
I run a small local-SEO agency in the UK. My clients are tradespeople - joiners, carpenters, kitchen fitters. I have around 90 warm leads sitting in my CRM who asked about my service and never got a proper follow-up, because I work a full-time job and cannot chase them during the day.

I want one person to work that list by SMS and book qualified prospects into my calendar.

These are warm leads, not cold lists. Every one of them filled in my own Facebook lead form and asked to hear from me. Most have had a message or a video from me already. You are picking up a conversation that started, not starting one from nothing.

WHAT YOU WOULD DO
- Work through my existing CRM list by SMS. I use GoHighLevel and you get a login.
- Qualify against three things: they run a real business, they have a website or a Google Business listing, and they will give me 15 minutes.
- Book them straight into my calendar. The calendar handles its own confirmations and reminders.
- Ring anyone who replies but stalls on picking a time. Voice is the fallback, not the main job.
- Log every attempt in the CRM with the outcome and a dated next step.

WHAT YOU WOULD NOT DO
- No pricing, no pitching, no negotiating. If they ask what it costs, that is my conversation and you hand it to me.
- No audits, no reports, no content, no admin.
- No editing, merging or deleting CRM contacts. Flag anything odd and leave it alone.
- No cold prospecting and no lead sourcing. The list exists.

title: Open  Textbook
desc:
The project is to take an open-access textbook from concept to publication under a permissive Creative Commons licence. The scope begins with shaping a clear table of contents and chapter outlines, followed by drafting the full narrative, worked examples, illustrations, exercises, and reference sections. Accuracy, pedagogical clarity, and consistent tone are essential throughout.

After the manuscript is complete, the work extends to page design and accessibility: clean, responsive typography, navigable headings, alt-text on every figure, and a hyperlinked table of contents. From a single source file (Markdown, LaTeX, or another tool we agree on) the book must export reliably to press-ready PDF, reflowable ePub, and a print-on-demand file set with correct bleed and trim.

Deliverables  
• Structured manuscript with all chapters, end-of-chapter problems, and answer key  
• Source files for text, images, and diagrams, clearly organised for future updates  
• Styled templates or CSS/TeX files that generate identical page numbers across formats  
• Final PDF, ePub, and print-ready files that pass accessibility checkers (e.g., EPUBCheck, PAC 3)  
• A brief build guide so the files can be regenerated by any instructor in the future

Acceptance criteria  
1. Content free of factual errors, plagiarism, and non-licensed assets  
2. Readability score appropriate to the agreed academic level  
3. All links, cross-references, and index entries resolve correctly in each format  
4. Export
